package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	svc "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const admissionRequestSchema = "student-onboarding-path-admission-request.v1"
const admissionMaterializationSchema = "student-onboarding-path-admission-materialization.v1"
const admissionResultSchema = "student-onboarding-path-materialization.v1"

func (c Client) ReserveOnboardingPathExecution(ctx context.Context, h domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, executionID, key string) (svc.OnboardingPathAdmission, error) {
	body := map[string]any{"schema": admissionRequestSchema, "handoff_id": h.HandoffID, "execution_id": executionID, "expected_state_ref": h.StateRef, "goal": h.Goal}
	var out admissionResponse
	err := c.doAdmission(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/students/"+url.PathEscape(h.StudentID)+"/onboarding-path-admissions", key, body, &out)
	if err != nil {
		return svc.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, err
	}
	if err := out.validate(h.StudentID, h.HandoffID, executionID, h.StateRef, h.Goal); err != nil {
		return svc.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return svc.OnboardingPathAdmission{AdmissionID: out.AdmissionID, Fence: out.Fence, Replayed: out.Replayed, ExpiresAt: out.ExpiresAt}, nil
}
func (c Client) RenewOnboardingPathExecution(ctx context.Context, handoff domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, admission string, fence int64, execution, key string) (svc.OnboardingPathAdmission, error) {
	var out admissionResponse
	err := c.doAdmission(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/students/"+url.PathEscape(handoff.StudentID)+"/onboarding-path-admissions/"+url.PathEscape(admission)+"/renewal", key, map[string]any{"schema": "student-onboarding-path-admission-renewal.v1", "execution_id": execution, "fence": fence}, &out)
	if err != nil {
		return svc.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, err
	}
	if err := out.validate(handoff.StudentID, handoff.HandoffID, execution, handoff.StateRef, handoff.Goal); err != nil || out.AdmissionID != admission || out.Fence < fence {
		return svc.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return svc.OnboardingPathAdmission{AdmissionID: out.AdmissionID, Fence: out.Fence, Replayed: out.Replayed, ExpiresAt: out.ExpiresAt}, nil
}
func (c Client) MaterializeOnboardingPathExecution(ctx context.Context, in svc.OnboardingPathMaterialization) (svc.OnboardingPathMaterialization, error) {
	var out materializationResponse
	lessons := make([]map[string]any, len(in.Lessons))
	for i, l := range in.Lessons {
		lessons[i] = map[string]any{"lesson_id": l.LessonID, "lesson_revision_id": l.LessonRevisionID, "targets": l.Targets}
	}
	body := map[string]any{"schema": admissionMaterializationSchema, "execution_id": in.ExecutionID, "fence": in.Fence, "course": map[string]any{"course_id": in.CourseID, "course_fingerprint": in.CourseFingerprint, "planner_policy_version": in.PlannerPolicyVersion, "reason_code": in.ReasonCode, "reason_summary": in.ReasonSummary}, "lessons": lessons}
	err := c.doAdmission(ctx, http.MethodPut, "/students/"+url.PathEscape(in.StudentID)+"/onboarding-path-admissions/"+url.PathEscape(in.AdmissionID)+"/materialization", in.IdempotencyKey, body, &out)
	if err != nil {
		return in, err
	}
	if out.Schema != admissionResultSchema || out.Status != "MATERIALIZED" || out.AdmissionID != in.AdmissionID || out.CourseID != in.CourseID || !isCanonicalUUID(out.AssignmentID) || !isCanonicalUUID(out.LearningPathID) || !isCanonicalUUID(out.FirstLessonID) || out.LearningPathVersion < 1 || out.JourneyVersion < 1 {
		return in, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	in.Status = "PATH_READY"
	in.LearningPathID = out.LearningPathID
	in.FirstLessonID = out.FirstLessonID
	in.Replayed = out.Replayed
	return in, nil
}
func (c Client) AbortOnboardingPathExecution(ctx context.Context, handoff domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, admission string, fence int64, execution, reason, key string) error {
	var out admissionResponse
	if err := c.doAdmission(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/students/"+url.PathEscape(handoff.StudentID)+"/onboarding-path-admissions/"+url.PathEscape(admission)+"/abort", key, map[string]any{"schema": "student-onboarding-path-admission-abort.v1", "execution_id": execution, "fence": fence, "reason": reason}, &out); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if out.Schema != "student-onboarding-path-admission.v1" || out.StudentID != handoff.StudentID || out.HandoffID != handoff.HandoffID || out.ExecutionID != execution || out.StateRef != handoff.StateRef || out.Goal != handoff.Goal || out.AdmissionID != admission || out.Status != "ABORTED" || out.Fence != fence || out.ExpiresAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

type admissionResponse struct {
	Schema      string                          `json:"schema"`
	AdmissionID string                          `json:"admission_id"`
	StudentID   string                          `json:"student_id"`
	HandoffID   string                          `json:"handoff_id"`
	ExecutionID string                          `json:"execution_id"`
	StateRef    domain.StudentReadinessStateRef `json:"state_ref"`
	Goal        domain.LearningReadinessGoal    `json:"goal"`
	Status      string                          `json:"status"`
	Fence       int64                           `json:"fence"`
	ExpiresAt   time.Time                       `json:"expires_at"`
	Replayed    bool                            `json:"replayed"`
}

type materializationResponse struct {
	Schema              string `json:"schema"`
	AdmissionID         string `json:"admission_id"`
	Status              string `json:"status"`
	CourseID            string `json:"course_id"`
	AssignmentID        string `json:"assignment_id"`
	LearningPathID      string `json:"learning_path_id"`
	FirstLessonID       string `json:"first_lesson_id"`
	LearningPathVersion int64  `json:"learning_path_version"`
	JourneyVersion      int64  `json:"journey_version"`
	Replayed            bool   `json:"replayed"`
}

func (out admissionResponse) validate(student, handoff, execution string, state domain.StudentReadinessStateRef, goal domain.LearningReadinessGoal) error {
	if out.Schema != "student-onboarding-path-admission.v1" || !isCanonicalUUID(out.AdmissionID) || !isCanonicalUUID(out.StudentID) || !isCanonicalUUID(out.HandoffID) || !isCanonicalUUID(out.ExecutionID) || out.StudentID != student || out.ExecutionID != execution || out.Status != "RESERVED" || out.Fence < 1 || out.ExpiresAt.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if handoff != "" && (out.HandoffID != handoff || out.StateRef != state || out.Goal != goal) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func (c Client) doAdmission(ctx context.Context, method, path, key string, body any, out any) error {
	if c.BaseURL == "" || c.WriteToken == "" || c.HTTPClient == nil || !isCanonicalUUID(key) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	b, e := json.Marshal(body)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	r, e := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal"+path, bytes.NewReader(b))
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	r.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.WriteToken)
	r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, e := c.HTTPClient.Do(r)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	raw, e := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20))
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		if resp.StatusCode == 409 {
			var failure struct {
				Error struct {
					Code string `json:"code"`
				} `json:"error"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(raw, &failure) == nil {
				switch failure.Error.Code {
				case "state_changed":
					return domain.ErrStateChanged
				case "active_path_exists":
					return domain.ErrActivePathExists
				}
			}
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		if resp.StatusCode == 422 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("student admission returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if e = d.Decode(out); e != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if e = d.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(e, io.EOF) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if replay, ok := out.(interface{ isAdmissionReplay() bool }); ok {
		if (resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK) != replay.isAdmissionReplay() {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (out *admissionResponse) isAdmissionReplay() bool       { return out.Replayed }
func (out *materializationResponse) isAdmissionReplay() bool { return out.Replayed }
